title: feat(enter): create and manage your sandboxes in the dashboard
author: xiaotian1171

gist.summary: Added a Sandboxes page at /sandboxes, after My Models in the Enter dashboard, where signed-in users can create, list, extend, pause, resume and delete their own E2B sandboxes through gen’s existing /alpha/e2b routes. Create, Add time and Resume show 10-minute, 1-hour, 8-hour and 24-hour choices with the Pollen charge before payment; Add time charges only for the unpaid portion. Time is paid in advance and is not refunded. The page shows the three-running-sandbox limit, notes that paused sandboxes do not count or cost anything, and displays gen’s balance and limit errors. Pause ends the lease; deleting a sandbox requires confirmation and removes its files without refunding paid time. Each sandbox card has a copyable ssh <id>.polli command and setup guidance. Added GET /alpha/e2b/pricing to return maxRunning, the per-second rates callers pay and the sizes of the pollinations and pollinations-large templates; logged-in template eligibility now derives from that size map. A test checks that dashboard price calculations match gen’s charges.

Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes: a prominent soft lime green (#ecf874) glow warms the cream-and-lavender scene, with chunky sprites, pixel flowers, subtle CRT scanlines and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
